# md.document parses its source while the program builds, so a source the
# build cannot know is refused where md.document is written.
#
# State is never known: refused right after the first optimize, at the call
# site, before a lowering can move the parse into a function it synthesized.
#
# A page's loop variable is known only to a target that writes a document per
# page (html, testdata/markdown_document_pages.txtar). bubbletea runs the loop,
# so the parse would be the program's to make.

! sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out state.sngl
stderr 'state.sngl:8:17: document''s source is read while the program builds, and draft is state, which it does not have until the program runs'

! sngl generate --platform bubbletea --lang go -o out pages.sngl
stderr 'pages.sngl:17:28: md.parse is answered only while the program builds, and this call was left for the program to make: call it with arguments known at build time'

sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out pages.sngl
exists out/a.html out/b.html

-- state.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import md "sngl:ui/markup/md"

var draft = "# hi"

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.button(text="edit", @click { draft = "# bye" })
    md.document(source=draft)
}
-- pages.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import md "sngl:ui/markup/md"

struct Doc {
    href string
    body string
}

const docs = [Doc{href="/a.html", body="# A"}, Doc{href="/b.html", body="# B"}]

ui.window(title=pages.current.title) {
    nav.stack #pages {
        for var d = docs {
            nav.page(href=d.href, title=d.href) {
                // The parse needs the page, which only a document per page has.
                md.document(source=d.body)
            }
        }
    }
}
